newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to expand sport vehicle output--newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to expand sport vehicle output--newspaper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd plans to expand the manufacture sport-utility vehicles to all four of its domestic factories, a Japanese business daily reported on Wednesday.
The vehicles are currently made at two of the plants and Nissan plans to start it at the other two plants by the autumn, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Nissan, Japan's second-largest automaker, aims to raise the ratio of sport-utility vehicle sales to more than half its total sales by 2000 from the current 40 percent, the paper said.
A Nissan spokesman declined to comment.
